title: Ropecon 2019: Essi Santala, Sampo Juustila: Odysseus – Where Code Meets Light and Sound
summary: A Ropecon 2019 talk by a lighting designer and a software engineer on how the Odysseus larp spaceship was built, using over ten IT systems, hundreds of lights and dozens of speakers. It covers the lessons learned.
why: HN people share it as a look at the custom backend and hardware behind a large sci-fi larp.

quote.text: Here's a video I found years ago by one of the volunteers talking about the work they put into the electronics.
